name: Can I install a new roof over my existing one?

mainEntity.name: Can I install a new roof over my existing one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a new roof over an existing one, known as a 'layover' or 're-cover,' is sometimes permissible but often not recommended. This method can save on tear-off costs but may void warranties, add excessive weight to your structure, and hide underlying damage. Local building codes often limit this practice, usually allowing only one re-cover over original shingles. A full tear-off and replacement generally ensures better long-term performance and allows for proper inspection of the roof deck.
acceptedAnswer.description: While sometimes allowed, installing a new roof over an old one is generally not recommended as it can hide damage, void warranties, and add weight. A full tear-off is usually best.
